questions.question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph shows the production of refrigerators by three companies in 2018.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b50df2e95c13389fb56c78e4c9d42fbc7b2a1bd5520931265c25d31dc2bc16e.png] 

The refrigerators produced by company C form what percentage of the total production?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Production by Company A in 2018 = 140 (in thousand)

Production by Company B in 2018 = 190 (in thousand)

Production by Company C in 2018 = 150 (in thousand)

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part / Total) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total production = 140 + 190 + 150

⇒ Total production = 480 (in thousand)

Percentage of Company C = (150 / 480) × 100

⇒ Percentage of Company C = 0.3125 × 100

⇒ Percentage of Company C = 31.25%

**∴ The refrigerators produced by Company C form 31.25% of the total production.**

questions.question: In the given histogram, which class is the median class?
questions.solution:
As we know,

If number of the observation is n is odd, then the median is [(n + 1)/2]th observation.

If number of the observation is n is even, then the median will be the average of the (n/2)th and [(n/2) + 1)]th observation.

Total number of students = 15 + 13 + 10 + 14 + 12 + 6 = 70

Median = [(70/2) + (70/2 + 1)]2 = (35 + 36)/2 = 35.5th (36th) students (which comes in 160 - 165)

Number of students who lies (150 - 155) = 15 students

Number of students who lies (155 - 160) = 13 students = 16th to 28th

Number of students who lies (160 - 165) = 10 students = 29th to 38th

So, 35.5th (36th) students comes in 160 - 165.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f3e7cdb7bfafbbf2f83dbf212566d7f719f455014e33faa0dce4ebfde59af8.png] 

 

In which year was the percentage of rise / fall in production from the previous year the maximum for company C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph shows the production (in lakh units) of kitchen appliances for Company C over the years:

**2012:** 70 lakh

**2013:** 90 lakh

**2014:** 120 lakh

**2015:** 80 lakh

**2016:** 110 lakh

**2017:** 140 lakh

**Formula used:**

Percentage change = frac{{New Value} - {Old Value}}{{Old Value}} times 100

**Calculations:**

From 2012 to 2013:

⇒ (90 - 70)/(70) times 100 = 28.57\% 

From 2013 to 2014:

⇒ (120 - 90)/(90) times 100 = 33.33\% 

From 2014 to 2015:

⇒ (80 - 120)/(120) times 100 = -33.33\% 

From 2015 to 2016:

⇒ (110 - 80)/(80) times 100 = 37.5\% 

From 2016 to 2017:

⇒ (140 - 110)/(110) times 100 = 27.27\% 

**∴ The maximum percentage change in production for Company C occurred from 2015 to 2016, with a 37.5% fall.**

questions.question: If 60% of the total number of students obtaining 50 marks or more but less than 70 marks are girls and 55% of the total number of students obtaining 70 marks or more but less than 90 marks are also girls, then the total number of girls obtaining 50 marks or more but less than 90 marks is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of girls who obtained 50 marks or more but less than 70

= (150 + 120) × (60/100) = 162

Total number of girls who obtained 70 marks or more but less than 90 marks

= (100 + 80) × (55/100) = 99

Total number of girls = 162 + 99

= 261

∴ The correct answer is **261**.

The following graph shows the number of boys and girls in class V, class VI, class VII and class VIII. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50100ada97937780005a199a82d74c0cb427acac284d1c152c2d79be99d00910.png] 

In which class, the percentage increase in the number of boys as compared to its previous class is least?
questions.solution:
Given:

Boys in class V = 65

Boys in class VI = 59

Boys in class VII = 60 

Boys in class VIII = 61

Concept Used:

Percentage Increase = (Boys in present class – Boys in a previous class)/Boys in previous class × 100

Calculations: 

Boys in class V = 65

Boys in class VI = 59

From class V to VI, the number of boys decreased.

Boys in class VII = 60

Percentage Increase = (60 – 59)/59 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 1.88% ----(1)

Boys in class VIII = 61

Percentage Increase = (61 – 60)/60 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 1.66% ----(2)

From (1) and (2), 

The required percentage increase is the least in class VIII.

∴ The class in which the **percentage increase in the number of boys as compared to its previous class is the least** is VIII.

**Calculation:**

Let the tank be filled in x minutes

For half the time D alone fill the tank

D's 1 minute work = 1/20

For 1st half = (x/2) × (1/20) = x/40

For second half C and D together work

C and D working together = (1/15 + 1/20) = 7/60

For second half = (x/2) × (7/60) = 7x/120

Total work is completed 

⇒ x/40 + 7x/120 = 1

⇒ 10x/120 = 1

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The tank will be filled in 12 minutes**

questions.question:
The bar graph below shows the production of coffee (in lakh tons) by four companies A, B, C and D over a period of four years from 2010 to 2013. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

The combined average production for four years of companies A and C is what percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) more/less than the combined average production for four years of companies B and D?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139e7f557467867c8b40e7f3acd9a006f6126f0c5ce59a20aaa7dbcd14b33aac.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph below shows the production of coffee (in lakh tons) by four companies A, B, C and D over a period of four years from 2010 to 2013. 

**Formula used:**

Combined average = (Sum of all values in Group 1 + Sum of all values in Group 2) / (Total number of values in both groups)

Percentage = (quantity1/quantity2) × 100 

**Calculation:**

The total production of coffee (in lakh tons) by company A over the period of four years = 60 + 90 + 140 + 220 = 510

The total production of coffee (in lakh tons) by company B over the period of four years = 70 + 100 + 150 + 210 = 530

The total production of coffee (in lakh tons) by company C over the period of four years = 50 + 190 + 180 + 250 = 670

The total production of coffee (in lakh tons) by company D over the period of four years = 120 + 170 + 200 + 260 = 750

Now,

The combined average production for four years of companies A and C is:

= (510 + 670)/8 = 147.5

The combined average production for four years of companies B and D is:

= (530 + 750)/8 = 160

Required percentage:

= [(160 - 147.5)/160] × 100

= 12.5/160 × 100

= 7.81% less

Hence, The combined average production for four years of companies A and C is 7.81% percentage less than the combined average production for four years of companies B and D.

**The correct answer is option 1.**

If the same percentage increase in the number of two wheelers as in 2014 over 2013 is expected in 2015, approximately how many two wheelers will be sold in 2015?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sales of two wheelers in 2013 = 13.8 million units

Sales of two wheelers in 2014 = 14.8 million units

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = [(Sales in 2014 - Sales in 2013) ÷ Sales in 2013] × 100

Estimated sales in 2015 = Sales in 2014 × (1 + Percentage increase)

**Calculation:**

Percentage increase = [(14.8 - 13.8) ÷ 13.8] × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (1 ÷ 13.8) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase ≈ 7.25%

Estimated sales in 2015 = 14.8 × (1 + 7.25 ÷ 100)

⇒ Estimated sales in 2015 = 14.8 × 1.0725

⇒ Estimated sales in 2015 ≈ 15.8 million units

**∴ Approximately 15.8 million two wheelers will be sold in 2015.**

questions.question:
The bar graph below gives the runs scored by Team A in the first six overs of a cricket match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69367b73bc65140420195ef05474fa0efee80e18a15a6dcd418348842faf9585.png] 

The runs scored by Team A in the 7th over was 5 more than the runs scored by them in the 8th over, but 6 less than the runs scored by them in the 9th over. If the average runs scored per over by Team A in the first nine overs of the match was 9, how many runs did the team score in the 8th over?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the run score by the team A in 7th over = x

Run score by the team A in 8th over = (x - 5)

Run score by the team A in 9th over = (x + 6)

Average run scored in first nine overs = 9

⇒ {4 + 15 + 8 + 7 + 10 + 3 + x + (x - 5) + (x + 6)}/9 = 9

⇒ 48 + 3x = 9 × 9

⇒ 3x = 81 - 48 

⇒ x = 33/3 = 11

Run score by the team in 8th over = (x - 5)

⇒ (11 - 5) = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**
